title: Customer account, my bookings, change, cancel and guest lookup
summary: A traveller creates a storefront account, books while signed in, finds the trip in My bookings, changes the contact details at the airline, cancels with the refund preview, sees the e-mails, keeps the session alive silently, and a guest finds a booking by reference.
prerequisites: Your OTA's storefront on the dev server with the airline card and *Self-service cancellation* on ([[journey:storefront-settings-and-markups]], step "switches").
Mailpit open. Use Chromium or Firefox (`__Host-` cookies on `http://localhost`).

steps.title: Create an account
steps.actions: Fill *First name*, *Last name*, *E-mail address*, *Password* and tick *I accept the terms and conditions…*, then press **Create account**. Try a 9-character password first, then the common `qwertyuiop`, then a good one of at least 10 characters.
steps.expect: The 9-character password is stopped by the browser itself (`minlength`, no request). `qwertyuiop` is refused at the field (`422 PASSWORD_TOO_WEAK`): "This password is too common or has appeared in a data breach. Choose another one." Then you land on `/account/` signed in, "Hi, <first name>" in the header (also when the OTA requires e-mail verification: that only blocks checkout). DevTools: the session lives in httpOnly cookies `__Host-vx_at` and `__Host-vx_rt`; the only cookie a script can read is `__Host-vx_csrf`. No token in localStorage or sessionStorage.
steps.data: `SELECT email, status, email_verified_at FROM tenant_<key>.customers ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1;` → the customer of **this** OTA only; a `customer_sessions` row.

steps.title: Verify the e-mail address
steps.actions: Open the storefront's verification e-mail and follow its link (`/account/verify.html?token=…`).
steps.expect: *Confirm your e-mail address* with *`<address>` is confirmed*.

steps.title: Sign out, then sign in from My bookings
steps.actions: Press **Sign out** in the header. Open `/bookings.html`.
steps.expect: Sign out returns to the home page. `/bookings.html` sends you to `/account/sign-in.html?next=%2Fbookings.html`; after signing in you are back on **My bookings**.

steps.title: Book a trip while signed in
steps.actions: Search and book with the airline card (`4111 1111 1111 1111`) as in [[journey:book-with-airline-card]]; the contact form is prefilled from the account.
steps.expect: The confirmation shows the reference. The trip appears under **Upcoming** in My bookings.

steps.title: Upcoming, past and cancelled tabs
steps.expect: Each tab changes the address (`?tab=upcoming|past|cancelled`) and lists the right trips with reference, route, dates and status. Empty tabs show an empty state.

steps.title: Change the contact details
steps.actions: Open the upcoming booking → **Change contact details**; in the dialog change *E-mail address*, *Country calling code* and *Mobile phone number*; **Save**.
steps.expect: The dialog closes and the page says "Your contact details are updated. We have sent a confirmation to <new address>."; **Contact details** shows the new address. Mailpit: "Your booking `VX…` with `<OTA>` has been updated" to the new address (with the itinerary) and "The contact details of booking `VX…` with `<OTA>` were changed" to the previous address (no booking data, no attachment).
steps.data: `bookings.contact_email` updated; a `booking_events` row; the PATCH to Amadeus in `supplier_requests`.

steps.title: Cancel with the refund preview
steps.actions: Press **Cancel booking**; read the preview in the dialog *Cancel your booking*; choose a reason in *Why do you cancel?*; press the button that names the amount (*Cancel and get … back*); **Close**.
steps.expect: The preview says "Your tickets can still be voided until …" and "If you cancel now, you get back … of the … you paid." After confirming the dialog says *Your booking is cancelled*; after **Close** the page heading is *This booking is cancelled* and **Cancel booking** is gone; the trip moves to the **Cancelled** tab. Mailpit: "Your booking `VX…` is cancelled".
steps.data: `bookings.status = cancelled`, `cancelled_by = customer`; for an airline card the expectation is recorded in `payment_events` and no Stripe refund is made; a new itinerary marked cancelled in `booking_documents`.

steps.title: The session refreshes silently
steps.actions: In DevTools → Application → Cookies delete `__Host-vx_at` (as the browser does after its 15 minutes). Open **My bookings** again.
steps.expect: The page loads without asking you to sign in; a new `__Host-vx_at` cookie appears (the refresh used `__Host-vx_rt`).
steps.data: `customer_sessions` shows the rotated refresh token (hash only).

steps.title: Account page
steps.actions: Look at the profile, change the password, and use *sign out everywhere*.
steps.expect: Password change requires the current password and the rule; sign out everywhere ends the session in other browsers too.

steps.title: A guest finds a booking by reference
steps.actions: In a private window: enter a real reference with a wrong last name, then a made-up reference (`VX2Z2Z2Z`) with the right last name, then the real reference in lower case with the right last name; press **Find my booking** each time.
steps.expect: The two wrong attempts show the same message, *We could not find a booking with these details*, without marking either field (the answers are identical but for the request id). The right pair opens `/booking.html?id=bkg_…`; access lives in the httpOnly `__Host-vx_bt` cookie.

steps.title: Failed lookups are limited
steps.actions: In another private window make six lookups with references that do not exist.
steps.expect: Five answers `404`, the sixth `429`: *Too many attempts, try again in N minutes* (the five failures are counted per IP for 15 minutes) and the button disabled until the wait ends.
